glosses.notes: Used before a verb to say something will happen very soon.

examples.sentence: 演出即将开始，请大家坐好。
新学期即将开始，孩子们很兴奋。
这辆车即将到站，请先准备下车。

example_translations.translation: The performance is about to begin, so please take your seats.
The new semester is about to start, and the children are very excited.
This train is about to arrive at the station, so please get ready to get off.

glosses.notes: Describes doing something quickly because of urgency.

examples.sentence: 听见门响，她急忙跑出去看。
老师一进门，大家急忙回到座位上。
我一看时间，急忙把电脑关了。

example_translations.translation: Hearing the door, she hurriedly ran out to look.
As soon as the teacher came in, everyone hurried back to their seats.
As soon as I looked at the time, I hurriedly shut the computer down.

glosses.notes: A formal adverb used to strengthen an adjective or verb phrase.

examples.sentence: 这条路晚上极其安静。
大家对这个结果极其满意。
这种天气对老人极其不方便。

example_translations.translation: This road is extremely quiet at night.
Everyone is extremely satisfied with this result.
This kind of weather is exceptionally inconvenient for older people.

glosses.notes: A group considered as a whole, especially when talking about shared responsibility or interests.

examples.sentence: 为了集体利益，大家都愿意让一步。
老师希望我们多为集体着想。
这是我们集体做出的决定。

example_translations.translation: For the good of the collective, everyone is willing to give a little.
The teacher hopes we will think more about the group as a whole.
This was a decision made by our group together.

glosses.notes: Used when something is badly needed right away.

examples.sentence: 医院现在急需这种药。
这个孩子急需家人的帮助。
公司发展太快，急需有经验的人。

example_translations.translation: The hospital urgently needs this medicine right now.
This child urgently needs the family's help.
The company is growing too fast and urgently needs experienced people.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to the ER department or getting emergency treatment at a hospital.

examples.sentence: 他半夜发烧，只好去医院挂急诊。
医院急诊晚上也有医生值班。
今天医院急诊来了很多病人。

example_translations.translation: He got a fever in the middle of the night, so he had to go to the hospital for emergency care.
The ER also has doctors on duty at night.
A lot of patients came to the ER today.

glosses.notes: As a verb, it can mean to focus attention, gather people or things together, or be concentrated in one area.

examples.sentence: 上课的时候要集中注意力。
问题集中在两个方面。
大家集中到门口等车。

example_translations.translation: You need to stay focused during class.
The problems mainly center on two areas.
Everyone gathered at the entrance to wait for the bus.

glosses.notes: Taught here as a verb meaning to press, squeeze, or push through a crowded space.

examples.sentence: 地铁一来，大家都往门口挤。
他从人群里慢慢挤了出来。
她把最后一点牙膏挤出来了。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the subway arrived, everyone crowded toward the door.
He slowly squeezed his way out of the crowd.
She squeezed out the last bit of toothpaste.

glosses.notes: Taught only in the sense of tying or fastening something, such as shoelaces, a belt, or a rope.

examples.sentence: 出门前别忘了系安全带。
孩子还不会自己系鞋带。
她先把头发系起来了。

example_translations.translation: Don't forget to fasten your seat belt before going out.
The child still can't tie shoelaces alone.
She tied her hair up first.

glosses.notes: One of the four three-month periods in a year.

examples.sentence: 公司第一季度的成绩不错。
这个季度的工作已经安排好了。
我们每个季度都会开一次会。

example_translations.translation: The company's results in the first quarter were good.
The work for this quarter has already been arranged.
We hold one meeting every quarter.

glosses.notes: Use 记录 for writing something down or for the record that has been written down. This row does not teach achievement records; that is 纪录.

examples.sentence: 请把会议内容记录下来。
这本笔记里记录了很多想法。
医生先看了一下病人的记录。

example_translations.translation: Please record the contents of the meeting.
A lot of ideas are recorded in this notebook.
The doctor first looked over the patient's record.

glosses.notes: Use 纪录 for a best result or achievement, especially in sports or competition. It is different from 记录 'to write down; written record'.

examples.sentence: 他打破了学校的长跑纪录。
这项纪录保持了很多年。
她又创造了新的世界纪录。

example_translations.translation: He broke the school's long-distance running record.
This record has stood for many years.
She set a new world record again.

glosses.notes: A nonfiction film or television program about real people, events, or topics.

examples.sentence: 这部纪录片真的很好看。
这部纪录片拍得很真实。
老师让我们周末看一部纪录片。

example_translations.translation: This documentary is really very good.
This documentary was filmed very realistically.
The teacher asked us to watch a documentary over the weekend.

glosses.notes: A practical ability that someone has learned and can use.

examples.sentence: 做饭也是一种生活技能。
他想学一门新的技能。
这份工作需要很强的沟通技能。

example_translations.translation: Cooking is also a life skill.
He wants to learn a new skill.
This job requires strong communication skills.

glosses.notes: Taught here as a verb meaning to remember and honor a person, event, or day. On its own, the noun use is less central; souvenirs are usually called 纪念品.

examples.sentence: 学校举行活动纪念老校长。
这座桥是为了纪念那位老师。
人们每年都会纪念这一天。

example_translations.translation: The school held an event to commemorate the former principal.
This bridge was built to commemorate that teacher.
People commemorate this day every year.

glosses.notes: A special day remembered every year because something important happened on that date.

examples.sentence: 今天是他们的结婚纪念日。
我总记得爸爸妈妈的纪念日。
这个纪念日对她很重要。

example_translations.translation: Today is their wedding anniversary.
I always remember my parents' anniversary.
This commemoration day is very important to her.

glosses.notes: To work out a number, result, or amount by counting or using math.

examples.sentence: 这道题可以用电脑计算。
他花了很久才计算出结果。
买东西前最好先计算一下花费。

example_translations.translation: This problem can be calculated with a computer.
It took him a long time to calculate the result.
Before buying things, it is best to calculate the cost first.

glosses.notes: A computer. This is a formal full form, where 电脑 is more common in everyday speech.

examples.sentence: 他大学学的是计算机。
这间教室里有二十台计算机。
现在很多工作都离不开计算机。

example_translations.translation: He studied computers at university.
There are twenty computers in this classroom.
Many jobs now cannot do without computers.

glosses.notes: As a noun, it means memory or a remembered impression. As a verb, it means to memorize or remember something intentionally.

examples.sentence: 这段记忆我一直忘不了。
年纪大了以后，记忆会变差。
她喜欢用画图的方法记忆单词。

example_translations.translation: I have never been able to forget this memory.
Memory can get worse as people grow older.
She likes to memorize words by drawing pictures.

glosses.notes: A formal verb used for recording or documenting information, especially in books, materials, and historical texts.

examples.sentence: 这本书里记载了很多当地的老故事。
资料里记载着很多老故事。
这些文字记载了当年的情况。

example_translations.translation: This book records many old local stories.
These materials document many old stories.
These words record what things were like back then.

glosses.notes: A respected guest invited to an event, show, or meeting.

examples.sentence: 今天来的嘉宾都是老师。
主持人请嘉宾先介绍自己。
节目开始前，嘉宾已经到齐了。

example_translations.translation: All of today's invited guests are teachers.
The host asked the guests to introduce themselves first.
Before the program started, the honored guests had all arrived.

glosses.notes: Electrical appliances used at home, such as refrigerators, washing machines, and TVs.

examples.sentence: 这家店卖各种家电。
商场打折时，我们买了不少家电。
这些旧家电还能继续用。

example_translations.translation: This shop sells all kinds of household appliances.
When the mall had a sale, we bought quite a few home appliances.
These old household appliances can still be used.

glosses.notes: To process raw materials or unfinished goods to make them ready for use or sale.

examples.sentence: 这些水果会送去工厂加工。
工人正在加工这些木头。
这家小厂主要加工衣服。

example_translations.translation: These fruits will be sent to the factory for processing.
The workers are processing this wood.
This small factory mainly processes clothing.

glosses.notes: To make food, water, or another object warmer by heating it.

examples.sentence: 牛奶凉了，先加热一下吧。
饭前把菜加热就可以吃了。
这种机器能很快把水加热。

example_translations.translation: The milk has gone cold, so heat it up first.
You can eat the dish after heating it before the meal.
This machine can heat water very quickly.

glosses.notes: To make a feeling, impression, understanding, or level stronger or deeper.

examples.sentence: 多练习可以加深记忆。
这次谈话加深了大家对问题的认识。
旅行以后，我对这座城的印象加深了。

example_translations.translation: More practice can deepen memory.
This conversation deepened everyone's understanding of the problem.
After the trip, my impression of this city became deeper.

glosses.notes: To make something go faster, or to begin going faster.

examples.sentence: 这辆车一上高速就开始加速。
公司正在加速发展新业务。
听到上课铃，他马上加速往前跑。

example_translations.translation: As soon as this car got onto the highway, it started to speed up.
The company is speeding up the development of new business.
When he heard the class bell, he immediately accelerated and ran forward.

glosses.notes: The everyday work needed to keep a home running, such as cleaning, cooking, and washing.

examples.sentence: 周末我在家做了一天家务。
孩子长大了，也该帮家里做家务。
她每天上班以后还要做家务。

example_translations.translation: I spent the whole weekend day at home doing housework.
The child has grown up and should help the family with household chores.
She still has to do housework every day after work.

glosses.notes: Taught here only as a label meaning category A or first-class, as seen in words like 甲班, 甲等, and 甲方. This row does not teach the armor sense.

examples.sentence: 学校把学生分到甲班学习。
他的作文这次得了甲等。
合同上写着甲方先签字。

example_translations.translation: The school placed the students into Class A to study.
His composition received a first-class grade this time.
The contract says that Party A signs first.

glosses.notes: Used to introduce a hypothetical condition. It is a little more formal than 如果.

examples.sentence: 假如明天下雨，我们就在家看书。
假如你是老师，你会怎么做？
假如没有地图，我们很难找到那里。

example_translations.translation: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay home and read.
Suppose you were the teacher. What would you do?
If we didn't have a map, it would be hard for us to find that place.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for planes and machines
secondary_glosses: measure word for pianos and cameras
glosses.notes: A classifier used for airplanes, pianos, cameras, and some machines or large instruments. This row does not teach the noun or verb senses.

examples.sentence: 刚才有一架飞机从机场起飞了。
音乐教室里有一架钢琴。
记者手里拿着一架照相机。

example_translations.translation: A plane just took off from the airport.
There is a piano in the music classroom.
The reporter is holding a camera in his hand.
